name: Naturalisation via Marriage to a Registration-Certificate Holder

requirements.blocker_text: Married to a person holding a Myanmar citizenship registration certificate (Section 45).
3 years' continuous residence in the State (Section 45).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of continuous residence in Myanmar as the spouse of a citizen.

sources.title: UNHCR Refworld -- Burma Citizenship Law, 1982 (English translation), Section 45: a foreigner married to a citizen holding a registration certificate may apply for naturalisation after residing continuously in the State for at least 3 years

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Myanmar). STATUS: DRAFT -- same tier-2-only sourcing limitation as mm_citizenship_naturalisation.json (UNHCR Refworld's hosted translation is the only text of the 1982 law located; no tier-1 Myanmar-government copy found). GENDER-NEUTRAL ON ITS FACE: Section 45's text as translated refers to 'a foreigner married to a citizen' without specifying the sex of either party, unlike some other countries built in this dataset (Nigeria, Qatar, Bahrain) where marriage-based citizenship is explicitly restricted to one direction only -- this is a notable structural difference worth flagging, though it rests on a single tier-2 translation rather than independently corroborated primary text. STRUCTURAL NOTE: this route requires the Myanmar-citizen spouse to specifically hold a 'registration certificate' (i.e., be a registered/associate or naturalised citizen under the law's own categories) rather than simply being 'a citizen' in the general sense -- the precise scope of which citizen sub-categories qualify was not further clarified in the source located. NO DEDICATED INTERIM RESIDENCE/DEPENDENT VISA WAS FOUND for a foreign spouse during the 3-year qualifying period leading up to this application -- presumably such a spouse relies on ordinary Stay Permit/FRC mechanisms (see mm_work_permit.json) rather than a distinct family-category visa; this is a genuine gap, not modeled as a separate family_reunification.json file in this build since no distinct spousal-residence route was located. dual_citizenship_allowed FALSE per Section 16, same as mm_citizenship_naturalisation.json.
